semantics.ordinary_p5_difference: Ordinary current P5 parser @0x10001190 repeats snapshot headers and uses an inline u8 length after every DID. Request @0x10001A30 attempts FF first, falling back to selected records @0x10001E90 on the first handled transport result or first zero-count response. P6 starts with selected nonzero records, separates confirmed/predictive readers, and uses DDB-fixed / inline-u8 / inline-be16 lengths. P6 requires the returned DTC already in its selected list; P5 can add a missing returned DTC. Both alternate-DID join and FFD flag were independently recovered in P6.

requests.additional_info: Optional @0x10003A90 uses selector13E and exported CGetFrzFrmDatPreAddInfo::m_lstDIDMap, writes DID at bytes1/2; activation follows command bytes+50/+51 in @0x10001160. Availability is recorded per category, not presumed.

residual_questions: Live support payload bits and selected snapshot numbers are vehicle responses, absent from this offline corpus.
Which command+50/+51 vehicle-type/additional-info selection is supplied for a particular vehicle requires its selected-DTC input; raw type171 groups and regional selector bindings are retained.

The additional-info request/parser accept vehicle types20..25 but their condition helper excludes that range. Current type171 row groups are retained rather than treating those branches as interchangeable.

responses.counts: Nonzero identifier_count bounds entries. Zero means parse until the next bounds failure. Zero-length entries are not added. Duplicate DIDs retain the first complete entry.
responses.geometry: DTC:be24 at2..4 | status at5 (read but not used here) | snapshot_record:u8 at6 | identifier_count:u8 at7 | DID entries from8. One snapshot header per selected-record response, not a repeated outer-record loop.
responses.length: SelectGetDIDLength @0x100A0080 queries type61 by DID(+2). Nonzero u16+4 supplies fixed payload length with NO inline length bytes. Absent row or zero length: DID<9000 uses inline u8 length; DID>=9000 uses inline be16 length.
responses.positive_check: Master frame receive_check (5904 in the concrete CF/D0 witnesses); parser itself starts at fixed offsets after transport matching.

transaction_results.success: Append returned CCommFrameData for parser; prune empty DTC lists after removal

responses.truncation: Header<8, incomplete DID/inline length/payload break parsing without manufacturing a DID. A truncated later entry leaves earlier complete DIDs available for signal analysis. These breaks normally return success, not a structural-error status.
responses.type_gate: GetFFDType @0x1009FA10 returns0 for other record numbers; parser abandons that response path.

signals.bounds_and_extract: bit_start/end=u16+3C/+3E. Required bytes=(end>>3)+1; short fields are skipped. Zero computed byte span is C0040102. FUN_100BFF7C extracts inclusive MSB0 bits into a 32-bit result; end<start returns C0000001.
signals.condition: Nonzero monitor+38 resets support then queries type80 by key+0. Variable ref+2 resolves Toyota master variable bytes; its first two bytes are referenced DID be16. CheckSupportBit @0x1009F580 searches the same parsed snapshot for that DID, requires condition type+0B==7, extracts bits+6/+8 and tests nonzero. Missing referenced DID excludes. CheckSupportPid does not propagate the CheckSupportBit return code.
signals.conversion: SetSignalInfo uses CCmdCommSignalLSBP6::InitInstance and ChangeSignalLSB. ChangeSignalLSB @0x100142C0 delegates only when category mode&1F==16. GetSignalLSB @0x10014930 looks up type64 by monitor key; missing-table A0030107 is a successful no-op. A row triggers live P6 support/ExecuteCommand before changing metadata; Mul/Div are normalized with GetCommonDivisorEuclid. The regional census records table64 availability.
signals.join: GetPidIdFromSSRDataId @0x1009FA70 scans type62 alternate DID u16+48 and returns monitor u16+34; AnalyzeSingleDataId @0x1009F230 requires byte+30&2.
signals.presentation: SetFrzFrmDat @0x100A0600 appends ordinary signals only for monitor+4B=0/1; timestamp/odometer/absolute-time special destinations are separate branches. Mode2 is therefore not an unknown transport mode. SetSignalInfo @0x100A1190 copies OEM name, type13 Mul/Div/Offset/signedness/decimal count, type15 unit, type14 patterns and calls P6 ChangeSignalLSB, not P5 ChangeSignalLSB.
signals.support: CheckSupportPid @0x1009F720 resolves type61 using alternate DID. Mode0 and2 include; mode1 requires (payload[(end>>3)-1] & (80>>(end&7))) == mask. End must be below payload_length*8. Missing DID rows/unknown modes are diagnostic paths, not new supported modes. Support result is cached by monitor key within this base object.
